plugins.name: arrow
plugins.description: Draws straight arrows with solid, open or hollow heads, single or double-ended; hold Shift to snap to 45 degrees.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 畫直線箭頭，箭頭可選實心、開口或空心；按住 Shift 以 45° 對齊。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 画直线箭头，箭头可选实心、开口或空心；按住 Shift 以 45° 对齐。

screenshots.alt: An arrow points at the Publish button on a documentation page.
Arrows are dragged onto a page, one snaps to 45° with Shift, and the panel switches to a hollow, dashed, double-headed style.

plugins.name: text
plugins.description: Places text anywhere on screen: click to type; Enter or click away commits as-is, Esc cancels, Shift+Enter adds a line; commits cannot be re-edited.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 點一下就能在畫面上打字標註，支援輸入法與多行，完成後可復原或重做。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 点一下就能在画面上打字标注，支持输入法与多行，完成后可撤销或重做。

screenshots.alt: Red text notes sit beside a blog post.
A click places a caret, a note is typed, and the font size is changed before it is committed.

plugins.name: spotlight
plugins.description: Dims the screen and follows the cursor with a soft circular spotlight to focus attention; radius, dim level and soft edge are adjustable.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 畫面變暗，只留一圈跟著游標移動的柔和聚光，把觀眾的視線帶到重點。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 画面变暗，只留一圈跟着光标移动的柔和聚光，把观众的视线带到重点。

screenshots.alt: A calendar is dimmed except for a spotlight on the Design review event.
The spotlight follows the cursor, then the panel changes its radius and dim level.

plugins.name: cursor-highlight
plugins.description: Adds a coloured glow that follows the cursor in screen shares and recordings, toggled from the control bar, plus an optional click ripple in drawing mode.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 游標周圍加上彩色光暈，分享螢幕時觀眾能一路跟上；可選點擊漣漪。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 游标周围加上彩色光晕，分享屏幕时观众能一路跟上；可选点击涟漪。

screenshots.alt: A yellow glow surrounds the cursor in a mail inbox.
The glow follows the cursor, then the panel changes its colour and size.

plugins.name: whiteboard
plugins.description: Fills the screen in one tap with an opaque whiteboard or blackboard backdrop beneath existing strokes, in white, black or a custom colour.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 一鍵鋪上不透明的白板或黑板底色，墊在既有筆跡下方；可選白、黑或自訂顏色。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 一键铺上不透明的白板或黑板底色，垫在既有笔迹下方；可选白、黑或自定义颜色。

screenshots.alt: Three boxes on a white board, the first two joined by a line.
One tap covers a code editor with a whiteboard, then boxes and lines are drawn on it.

plugins.name: step-marker
plugins.description: Drops sequentially numbered circular markers on click for step-by-step annotations, numbering by canvas marker count so undo rolls the next number back.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 點一下放下依序編號的圓形標記，適合逐步說明操作步驟。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 点一下放下依序编号的圆形标记，适合逐步说明操作步骤。

screenshots.alt: Markers numbered 1, 2 and 3 sit on a settings page.
Numbered markers are dropped one by one; undo rolls the next number back.

plugins.name: attention-box
plugins.description: Drag out a coloured frame that holds for two seconds and then fades on its own, to steer viewers to one area of the screen; agents can draw one through OpenPen's MCP endpoint.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 拖出彩色外框把觀眾視線帶到畫面某一塊，停兩秒後自動淡出，不用手動清除。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 拖出彩色外框把观众视线带到画面某一块，停两秒后自动淡出，不用手动清除。

screenshots.alt: An amber attention box frames the Jun row of a sign-up table while a blue one fades, with the options panel open.
